text_block_list.text:
To bring passion back to the racing world, 
she would become the villain who fiercely 
stokes everyone's fighting spirit—

The high-profile press conference paid 
off, and before long, Mejiro Ramonu was 
dubbed the "Villainous Lady," becoming the 
common enemy of the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: An offer to appear on a TV show?
choice_data_list:
It is a chance to promote you and the 
races, but...

It's an opportunity to promote you and the 
races, but...

text_block_list.text:
"Will the villainess triumph, or the 
challenger?! A hot, thrilling survival 
race!" —That was what was written in the 
proposal.
choice_data_list:
...As you can see, the contents are a 
bit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Then I will enter. Is there any reason to 
hesitate?

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu... There's no way I'm losing 
to someone like her!

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly, that's the spirit! Let's 
defeat the villainous young lady together!
choice_data_list: (Whoa, talk about feeling out of place.)

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—The rules are simple! Navigate the 
designated course, and whoever crosses the 
finish line first wins!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
You can also hit your rivals with the ink 
balls we handed out to eliminate them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I see. Then I shall not be needed there.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But doing that would put you at a 
huge disadvantage—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"How strange of you. Did you truly think I 
would be hunted by such a dull beast?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: W-What did you saaaay~?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You little...! Why...! I can't hit it at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
What a buzzkill. Are you relying on tacky 
props because you lack confidence?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to toy with and trample me, 
then come at me in earnest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Why not prove with those legs of yours 
that you are not one of the weak?

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...! Alright, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Kh, dammiiiiit!! What is up with that 
speed...?!

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Not yet...! I'll catch up from here...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu... ...Ah, that would be lovely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Your thirst for victory, your breathing, 
your stride— everything is far more 
wonderful than before.

Hair disheveled, clothes covered in mud. 
Yet none of them mind, sprinting with 
reckless abandon.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Clash with me more, make my blood boil.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "To offer it... it is still not enough."

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...*Haah*, *haah*. I... couldn't... reach 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
...Still, maybe I ran a lot faster than 
usual...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: How lovely. —...However.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
What you displayed at the very end was 
quite a formidable fervor.

text_block_list.name: Rival Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I――we will get even stronger! Next time, 
we're definitely going to win...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—It's over now. Everything went without a 
hitch.

Once today's program airs, Mejiro Ramonu's 
fame will surely rise. And what's more—
choice_data_list:
The way everyone ran in the second half 
was like they were completely different 
people.

The way everyone ran in the second half 
was like they were completely different 
people.

text_block_list.text:
Inspired by Ramonu, the Umamusume seemed 
to be using their anger as fuel to break 
through their shells.
choice_data_list:
...Is their growth all part of the plan 
too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...Now then.
